user_query: I'm planning a beach party with my friends this weekend. Can you recommend some popular tracks from the Turkey Songs chart that we can play at the party? It would be great if you could also provide us with the details of the top track on the chart and the artist behind it.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current Turkey Songs chart to get popular tracks.
Extract a list of popular tracks from the Turkey Songs chart.
Obtain details of the top track on the Turkey Songs chart, including artist name and song details.
